name: A Dolls Lament
source:
A Visual Novel about a Doll in an antique store that is missing some parts and therefore never gets chosen to be taken home by someone. After she gets thrown away by the store owner, there's only the darkness and loneliness comforting her. Wanting to give up she closes her eyes...until she hears someone humming a melody.

[From [url=https://alinalinaa.itch.io/a-dolls-lament]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于古董店里的玩偶的视觉小说，它缺少一些零件，因此永远不会被人选择带回家。被店主扔掉后，安慰她的只有黑暗和孤独。想要放弃，她闭上了眼睛……直到她听到有人哼着旋律。

[来自[url=https://alinalinaa.itch.io/a-dolls-lament]itch.io[/url]]
